test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)

question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Indefatigable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indefatigable** - (of a person or their efforts) persisting tirelessly; untiring.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Indefatigable**.
